plugins.name: matthewzammit-skills
plugins.description: figma-from-code (rebuild an app in Figma from its code), figma-sync (keep it updated), dev-loop-audit (CI, git hooks and AI agent time), qol-pass (a quality pass on one section of an app), session-retro (fix what went wrong in an agent session), weekly-audit (a weekly review of what changed) and weekly-progress-note (a plain-words weekly update).
